resources.string: Self-test passed: all four probes were answered, the adapter really sends even parity (8E1).

Parity not in effect: 7F, 01 FE and 02 FD were answered but 00 FF was not. Only bytes with an odd number of set bits are accepted, so the adapter is transmitting 8N1 and the STM32 discards 0x00 as a parity error. Use a genuine CH340G/CH341 or a CP2102 adapter (some CH340E and clone chips do not support even parity).
No answer at all: check that TX/RX are crossed and GND is common, and that the baud rate matches the chip. You can also switch to mode 0 (manual button) and pull BOOT0 high before pressing reset.
